thread:
alex: noticed slow initial render on per-route analytics when model filters are expanded. cold load p95 ~2.1s.
riley: same. client does route-summary then spikes with N model-metrics calls.
samir: can we add a single /api/console/route_view_combined that returns route + model slices? would cut RTTs.
evie: product concern: aggregated calls will increase telemetry consumption. need a way to respect org sampling quotas and be transparent to users.
alex: proposal: saved-query attaches prefetch_setting: none|route|models. default none for free orgs, auto for paid where quota allows.
riley: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?expand=prefetch&model_sample=0.2 -> meta: {prefetch_applied: "models", sample_rate: "0.2", quota_state: "OK"} (client renders message if downgraded).
samir: ops: emit meter tag console.view.telemetry with org_id and view_id, and emit event on fallback. ops wants a header X-Prefetch-Downgraded when server returns less than requested.
evie: UX: add toggle "Include per-model telemetry" persisted on saved views. tooltip: "May increase telemetry usage; we may sample or fallback if quota is constrained." show inline estimate of added latency on first load.
console-bot: perf: staging combined endpoint median 390ms (was 2.1s), p95 940ms (was 3.6s). run cpref-2026-03-21.
billing-bot: will document meter requirements. ensure cached responses still emit billing pings so we can attribute.
alex: owners: samir backend PR, riley client PR + saved-query schema change, evie UX copy + figma. i'll open umbrella ticket with acceptance criteria: combined endpoint, saved-view flag persisted, visible quota/cost hint, downgrade meters.
riley: will draft client changes today.
samir: prototyping downgrade logic and cache-control in staging.
evie: will mock the toggle and microcopy.
console-bot: ci: console/prefetch-integration passed.
alex: thanks all, we'll track progress on the umbrella ticket.
